title: Restricted Hupsel SWETR=0 PMdirect typed application composition
canonical_base_note: Current canonical includes the separately admitted F-ROSS12 adapter-only surface. F-APP04 has no RossFast dependency and must not wire or alter it.
scientific_contract: Implement the exact restricted SWETR=0 / SWDIVIDE=1 daily PMdirect route separately from the admitted SWETR=1 reference-ET process.

Daily PMdirect consumes immutable daily measured weather plus site and canopy resistance/albedo geometry required by the exact legacy route and produces potential soil evaporation, dry-canopy transpiration, wet-canopy evaporation demand and pond evaporation demand.
ETpot semantics convert legacy mm/day PMdirect outputs to cm/day and apply the admitted crop CO2 transpiration factor only where the exact legacy route does so.
A12 supplies exact daily interception/net-rain semantics for the restricted Hupsel SWINTER=1 branch.
ProcessMeteoDT composition derives the bounded wet fraction from A12 interception and A13 wet-canopy evaporation capacity, then mixes wet- and dry-canopy potential transpiration for the interval.
No crop-factor multiplication is permitted on PMdirect ptra. The SWCF=1 canopy geometry/resistance route is not the SWETR=1 reference-ET route.
The existing admitted SWETR=1 reference-ET implementation must remain byte-identical in F-APP04.

crop_canopy_boundary: crop-specific canopy resistance/albedo/geometry scalars actually consumed by the exact PMdirect route
typed_boundary_requirements.authority_rule: No field may receive a guessed default or inferred unit. Before implementation, each consumed scalar must be traced to the exact F-APP03 rederivation / SWAP 4.3.1 MOD_meteo authority or an already admitted typed SWAP5 contract.

required_noninterference: existing SWETR=1 reference-ET production blob unchanged
O0/O2 identity for the new typed process/composition
fail-closed invalid/nonfinite forcing or unsupported route
no mutation of committed hydrologic state by demand calculation
no solver, timestep, retry, mass-policy or tolerance change

allowed: small typed binding to already admitted downstream forcing/root-uptake surfaces where units and signs are established
owner tests and deterministic oracle comparison tooling
not_allowed: file-driven M1-C3 adapter implementation in this workunit
output fitting or post-hoc tolerance relaxation

next_permitted_action: Recover the exact scalar/formula authority needed for the restricted PMdirect typed fields, bind every field/unit explicitly, then implement only the preregistered process/composition. If any required scalar authority cannot be recovered exactly, fail closed and persist the missing-authority blocker instead of inventing a formula or default.
